title: Watch your steps: Dormant Adversarial Behaviors that Activate upon LLM Finetuning

layout.note: Three actor columns of unequal width (Adversary, Model Sharing Pipeline, User), each captioned underneath with a rule above; the model robot moves left to right through circled steps 1 to 5, crossing the columns. A red-outlined detail box hangs above the first arrow.

lesson: Follow one character through numbered steps across actor columns and recolour it at each step (blue benign, red adversarial), so state changes need no text; hang a red-outlined detail box with a V pointer on the first arrow to open its inner algorithm.
